newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-MOYA, RIOS SUFFER ON GRASS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MOYA, RIOS SUFFER ON GRASS.

text.p: Carlos Moya and Marcelo Rios did little to boost their fragile confidence on grass on Monday as both crashed out of the Nottingham Open in the first round.
The top-seeded Moya from Spain, seeded 10th at Wimbledon which starts next week, did his best to fight back after a poor start but still lost 1-6 7-6 6-4 by Romanian Adrian Voinea.
Chilean Rios, another claycourt specialist with scant experience on grass, also failed to justify his status as the tournament's second seed by going down 6-4 6-2 to Denmark's Kenneth Carlsen.
